name: Ramp
text: We should adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity. This decision provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard navigation while minimizing visual noise for mouse users. By choosing this option, we're accepting a slight trade-off in terms of focus ring prominence, as a 3px solid ring might be more noticeable, but the inset design provides a better balance between aesthetics and accessibility. This choice aligns with our goal of making EXCAVA usable by everyone, particularly those relying on keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: The 2px #005fcc ring with 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity fails WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on dark backgrounds—risking exclusion for low-vision users. A 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px #fff outer stroke meets WCAG 2.2 AA while keeping the ring visible on all backgrounds. Settle with a live contrast checker and user testing with screen-reader users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks looking like a border on some interactive elements, breaking the visual distinction between focus state and component edges. A better alternative is a 2px #005fcc ring with a 1px #fff outer stroke at 80% opacity—this meets WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds while staying thin enough to avoid confusion. Settle with a live contrast checker and side-by-side visual review against component mockups.
